ComposerLint Windows renderer source and wheel notices
Revision date 2026-11-16

Verovio 6.3.0 is Copyright (c) Authors and others. See the source headers
and COPYING and COPYING.LESSER. ComposerLint changed the Windows edition
to replace font resources, emit the renamed embedded music face and omit
two optional fonts and footer artwork on 2026-11-16. The tie1 variant also
carries the dated MusicXML tie modification in LOCAL-TIE-FIX-NOTICE.txt.
Both variants are local builds. Verovio's LGPL terms apply to the
renderer. The fonts and other third-party works retain their own terms.

Native and generated components

  humlib                       humlib-NOTICES.txt
  JSON++                       JSONplusplus-LICENSE.txt
  pugixml                      pugixml-NOTICES.txt
  MINIZ-CPP and miniz           MINIZ-CPP-miniz-NOTICES.txt
  Surge Synth Team Tuning      tuning-library-LICENSE.txt
  CRC                         CRC-NOTICES.txt
  MidiFile                     MidiFile-51eec11-LICENSE.txt
  Modified LibMEI              LibMEI-LICENSE.txt, LibMEI-AUTHORS.txt
  MEI compiled ODD inputs       MEI-ECL-2.0.txt, retained ODD headers
  SWIG 4.5.1 library output     SWIG-4.5.1-LICENSE-SWIG.txt

MidiFile is by Craig Stuart Sapp. Verovio retains a locally differing
MidiMessage.cpp. Its full imported source and notices are retained.
LibMEI is from the Distributed Digital Music Archives and Libraries Lab,
McGill University, with Verovio's local modifications. The source kit
includes the exact generated code, generator, schema and configuration.
The Music Encoding Initiative Board (formerly MEI Council) publishes the
MEI schema, derived from earlier work copyright 2001–2006 Perry Roland.
The archived MEI input pin is 6da4dd5071303ac53d73d7b5ea0399f9cfe7bdba.
The SWIG wrapper is generated from Verovio's bindings/python/verovio.i.
The SWIG program is a separately provisioned build tool. The copied
runtime fragments in its generated output have the SWIG library terms.

Font Software under SIL Open Font License 1.1

  Bravura 1.392                Bravura-1.392-OFL.txt
    Unmodified Steinberg OTF. Retained SVG outlines from Steinberg's
    original SVG and the matching SMuFL metadata. Derived engraving
    metrics use the primary name ComposerLint Engraving Glyphs.

  Leland 0.80                  Leland-0.80-OFL.txt
    Unmodified MuseScore OTF. Regenerated engraving paths and bounding
    boxes from that OTF. Derived metrics use the primary name
    ComposerLint Modern Glyphs. Preserved publisher SMuFL anchors.
    Designers Martin Keary and Simon Smith.

  ComposerLint Music           Leipzig-OFL.txt
    Based on the retained Leipzig 5.2.102 TrueType and SVG source that
    RISM Digital Center shipped with Verovio 6.3.0. Creators Etienne
    Darbellay, Jean-Francois Marti, Laurent Pugin and Klaus Rettinghaus.
    The modified TrueType face uses ComposerLint Music and the PostScript
    name ComposerLintMusic-Regular. The engraving resource keys remain
    internal. The SVG glyph paths and SMuFL metadata retain their sources.

  Liberation Serif 2.1.5       Liberation-2.1.5-OFL.txt,
                               Liberation-2.1.5-AUTHORS.txt
    The Regular, Bold, Italic and Bold Italic fonts are unmodified. The
    ComposerLint Serif Metrics tables are generated from those fonts.
    The Times filenames are internal Verovio resource keys.

An eventual Windows distribution needs a separate Microsoft runtime
entry if it includes runtime DLLs. This source material contains no
Microsoft runtime DLLs. Microsoft terms govern any authorized DLL copies
and do not alter rights to modify or debug the Verovio renderer.
